detail.command:
set -euo pipefail
changed_paths="$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard server | sort)"
printf '%s\n' "$changed_paths"
unexpected="$(printf '%s\n' "$changed_paths" | grep -Ev '^server/(package\.json|tsconfig\.json|\.env\.example|\.gitignore|README\.md|src/(types|config|store|auth|index)\.ts)$' || true)"
if [ -n "$unexpected" ]; then printf 'Unexpected paths:\n%s\n' "$unexpected"; exit 1; fi
file_count="$(printf '%s\n' "$changed_paths" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
[ "$file_count" = 10 ]
for required in server/package.json server/tsconfig.json server/.env.example server/.gitignore server/README.md server/src/types.ts server/src/config.ts server/src/store.ts server/src/auth.ts server/src/index.ts; do
  printf '%s\n' "$changed_paths" | grep -Fx "$required" >/dev/null
done
if git status --short --untracked-files=all | grep -v '^?? server/' >/tmp/msngr-unexpected-status.txt; then
  cat /tmp/msngr-unexpected-status.txt
  exit 1
fi
printf 'scope_ok files=%s\n' "$file_count"
